_comment: The Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque's interiors (components/interior/abuDhabi/scenes): what the prayer hall and the courtyard are drawn from. Facts from the mosque centre (szgmc.gov.ae): the main prayer hall's walls in Italian white marble; 96 marble columns inlaid with mother-of-pearl vines and flowers, with gilded palm capitals; the qibla wall inscribed with the 99 Names of Allah in Kufic script, lit from behind by fibre optics; the world's largest hand-knotted carpet (about 5,400 m², 35 tonnes, mostly New Zealand wool); seven chandeliers, the largest 12 m across and 15.5 m tall, in gold-plated stainless steel and coloured crystal; 82 white domes; the Sahn, a courtyard of floral marble mosaic, with reflecting pools along the arcades.
